title: Let’s plan something wonderful
intro: Tell us a little about your trip and we’ll prepare a WhatsApp enquiry. No payment or server-side form submission.

steps.title: When will you visit?
steps.description: An approximate date is absolutely fine.

steps.title: Who’s coming along?
steps.description: Give us your estimated number of guests.

steps.title: Anything else we should know?
steps.description: Cities, interests, accessibility or special requests.

submitLabel: Send my trip idea via WhatsApp
successNote: Your WhatsApp app will open with the enquiry. You must press Send there; the website does not submit it automatically.
